listing.name: Hapibit Church Planner
listing.oneLiner: Find church ministry plans, review preparation and budgets, and create, update, or carry plans into a later year within your church permissions.
listing.description: Hapibit Church Planner connects conversations to ministry plans in your Hapibit church. Church administrators and ministry leaders can check their connected church and role, search ministries by year, department, status, or text, and read details permitted by their role. Year searches include ministries that overlap the selected year. With write access, create ministry drafts, update selected fields after reviewing the latest record, and roll a ministry forward to a later year. Changes require confirmation, and rollover resets spending and completion state. The connector provides six tools and returns structured data. It does not send messages, make payments, delete ministries, expose the congregant directory, or read weekly journals and annual department budgets. A Hapibit account, church membership, and an authenticated connection are required.

primary: Understand the connected church and the user's ministry permissions.
Find ministry plans and review dates, preparation tasks, and permitted budget details.
Create a ministry draft after the user confirms its contents.
Change selected fields while preserving the rest of the ministry record.
Carry a ministry into a later year as a draft with completion and spending reset.
prerequisites: Hapibit account with active church membership.
An OAuth connection approved on Hapibit for the displayed read or write permissions.
An appropriate church role, write-capable connection, and accepted community rules for writes.

authenticationStatus.implemented: OAuth authorization code flow with S256 PKCE, dynamic registration for public clients, planner:read and planner:write scopes, rotating refresh tokens, and revocation. Personal Bearer keys remain supported for private clients.
